$comment: Social handles per place slug. A Threads profile is the venue's Instagram account — the username is shared 1:1 — so `instagram` doubles as the Threads handle and the page is https://www.threads.com/@<handle>. Handles are NOT derivable from the venue name (see chill_skybar, secretgardenvn, blankloungelandmark), so every one is looked up by hand. `threads_status`: confirmed = the account's own profile page or its own post was seen on threads.com; unverified = the Instagram handle is confirmed but no Threads content has been seen yet, so the account may not have been activated on Threads. Re-check with scripts/verify-threads.mjs.

blank-lounge.note: Brand name on both accounts is Blank Sky Lounge, not Blank Lounge.

workshop-coffee.note: Facebook uses the.workshop.coffee — the dots are Facebook-only, Instagram has none.

chill-skybar.note: Underscore, and no 'saigon' suffix despite the venue name.

shin-coffee.note: Handle follows the Vietnamese brand SHIN Cà Phê, not the English 'SHIN Heritage'.

secret-garden.note: Generic name — the vn suffix is what disambiguates it.

cong-caphe-dong-khoi.note: Chain with per-country handles (congcaphe.ca, congcaphe.tw both live on Threads). The Vietnam account has not been pinned down — do not assume plain 'congcaphe'.
